content:
Single Grain is a premier AI-first growth marketing agency. It focuses on scaling revenue, pipeline generation and customer acquisition. These services are especially useful for B2B SaaS, enterprise tech, and high-growth e-commerce companies.The company was founded and led by Eric Siu with headquarters in Los Angeles. Single Grain has established its unique identity through revenue-first marketing execution, programmatic SEO, advanced paid media scaling, conversion-focused funnel engineering, and direct access to senior specialists.Some of their high-profile clients include Uber, Amazon, Salesforce, Lyft, and Nordstrom

How does Single Grain work?

Single Grain helps businesses to scale digital revenue using the following steps:

Growth Audit and Strategic Blueprint- Every engagement at Single Grain starts with a deep-dive audit. 

    1. Funnel Analysis - Teams begin work by analysing conversation funnels, ad account efficiency, SEO architecture, customer acquisition paths, and tracking infrastructure. 
    2. Competitor Reverse Engineering - The agency's experts study their competitors' keywords, ads, creative assets, funnels, traffic sources, and content gaps to find scalable opportunities. 

Agile Execution Model- It uses a specialised execution model with the following features:

    1. Direct Specialist Access- Single Grain has removed traditional account managers. So clients can connect directly with experts.
    2. Weekly Growth Sprints- They optimize campaigns through rapid execution cycles over slow quarterly review systems. 
    3. Dedicated Slack Collaboration- The majority of their clients work through real-time collaborative community channels.

Continuous Optimisation- Single Grain continuously optimises its campaign with A/B testing for Landing pages, Ad creatives, Headlines, funnel copy and user journeys. For this purpose, they also use Revenue Attribution and Predictive AI Scaling.

Core Capabilities

Revenue-Focused SEO

Single Grain prioritises: 

Technical SEO: The agency manages indexing, optimisation, internal linking, metadata, site speed, etc. 

Link Acquisition - Single Grain focuses on building authority through backlinks by leveraging relevant publications and websites.

Multi-Channel Paid Media

 Single Grain uses:

Paid Advertising Platforms- They manage campaigns across Google Ads, Meta, LinkedIn, TikTok, YouTube and Amazon Ads.

Dynamic Creative Testing- Its automated testing frameworks rotate visuals, Hooks, Headlines, CTAs and formats for maximum performance. 

Content Marketing and Authority Building

Single Grain works on different methods to build industry authority using:

Thought Leadership Content- They make blogs, white papers, E-books, video content and email nurture systems.

Multi-format repurposing- Single Grain's content team repurposes long content into social snippets, video clips, short-form posts, email sequences and more.

AI and Revenue Operations

Single Grain works on marketing automation to implement AI workflow in CRMs, email systems and pipeline automation tools.

What makes Single Grain stand out?

The digital marketing market is filled with AI-powered agencies. But, Single Grain is different due to the following reasons:

  • AI-First Infrastructure: Single Grain leads many traditional agencies in AI adoption.
  • Proprietary Growth Tools - The agency uses specialised tools such as Clickflow, AI optimisation systems, and predictive scaling methods. It helps with both SEO and paid-acquisition automation. 
  • No account manager model- Clients get to work directly with senior specialists instead of account managers or any intermediaries. 
  • Revenue Over Vanity Metrics- Single Grain agency focuses mostly on pipeline growth, conversions, revenue, LTV and ROAs over traffic.

Key Services

Some of their key services and expertise include:

  • Paid Media Management- It includes search ads, social ads, retargeting, marketplace advertising, and podcast sponsorships. 
  • Enterprise SEO- They focus on Technical SEO, programmatic SEO, revenue-focused search strategy and AI search optimisation.
  • Content Marketing - Single Grain produces editorial content, case studies, Video Assets, White Papers, and Social Content Systems.
  • Web3 and Crypto Marketing- It provides specialised growth systems for NFT projects, DeFi protocols, Crypto platforms, and Blockchain ecosystems.

Advanced Capabilities

Single Grain's multiple years of experience and specialist teams have shaped its advanced capabilities in: 

  • Search Everywhere Optimisation- Single Grain optimises for visibility of their clients inside Google search, AI engines, LLM-generated results and conversational AI systems.
  • AI Engine Optimisation (AEO)- They build content structures designed to improve discoverability in AI-generated search experiences. 
  • Predictive Attribution Systems- The agency's server-side and AI-enhanced attribution tracks conversions with accuracy. 
  • AI-Powered Funnel Forecasting- Its machine learning models predict funnel leakage, conversion likelihood, retention behavior and scaling potential.

Best Fit Industries

  • On-demand Apps and Marketplaces 
  • Edtech 
  • Fintech and Web3
  • Enterprise Technology 
  • B2B SaaS

Who should work with Single Grain?

Single Grain's AI-first growth model, scaling revenue, and pipeline generation and more specialisations are ideal for:

  • Funded Startups- Scale-Stage SaaS companies, Enterprise brands, and rapidly-growing ecommerce businesses 
  • Series A-Series C Startups- Businesses under pressure to quickly scale predictable revenue 
  • Enterprise Organisations- Companies that need advanced attribution SEO, ABM, and multi-channel growth systems.

Key Use Cases

  • Recovering Organic Traffic- Single Grain uses Technical SEO and Programmatic SEO to reverse the decrease in traffic.
  • Scaling Paid Acquisition- It improves ROAs and reduces CAC across paid channels.
  • Web3 Growth- Single Grain scales Crypto ecosystems and blockchain communities.
  • Product Launch Campaigns- They quickly launch high-volume acquisition campaigns for new initiatives.

Pros 

  • AI-first growth systems
  • Fast execution cycles 
  • Strong enterprise client validation
  • Excellent technical infrastructure 
  • Direct access to senior experts 
  • Revenue-focused methodology 
  • Strong SaaS and enterprise expertise

Considerations 

  • Some content could be broad instead of being deep or technical
  • Heavy automation focus could be challenging for traditional brands
  • Premium price structures  
  • A fast-paced operations style may overwhelm slower internal teams

Top Alternatives

  • MarketJoy- Specializes in multi-channel B2B lead generation services
  • Directive Consulting- Impressive Enterprise B2B SaaS growth.
  • NoGood- Exceptional startup growth hacking and quick experimentation.
  • Refine Labs- Exceptional B2B pipeline strategy and demand generation transformation.

Summing Up

Single Grain is one of the best technical revenue acceleration partners with a modern outlook. They have exceptional AI-first execution, Programmatic SEO, paid scaling and revenue attribution, among others.They are ideal for working with SaaS, enterprise tech, and growth-stage e-commerce companies with strong budgets. At the same time, it is one of the most technically advanced growth agencies operating today.Are you looking for a digital marketing agency to bring an AI-powered workflow to improve your results? Single Grain might be your ideal partner in the journey of growth.
